definition: a building for one particular activity
description: In a climbing centre built inside an old empty indoor swimming pool with a glass roof and big arched windows, a young woman with a long braid hangs from coloured holds on a steep overhanging wall high above the tiled pool. She swings, reaches up, kicks her legs and hooks one leg back up, while chalk dust puffs in the air and a rope hangs below her. Down in the dry pool people climb the tiled walls over thick blue and red mats, a metal pool ladder remains on the side, and a small cafe counter stands at the back.

taps.phrase: to hang from the steep wall
